title: Tutorial: The Host
notes: The first content pack (DESIGN §8): five sessions, levels 0 to 30, thirty in-game days on a colossal cosmic humpback whale with its own star and moons. The players are cell-sized and believe they are purging a curse; they are the infection, and the curse is the whale's immune response. Import it into a new campaign before session 1. Untick anything you want to run differently. Factions are left to play: survivors gather around the players' choices and become the Earth-arc cast.

quests.title: The World Is Dying
quests.text: The world is dying. Find what is killing it. Delve to the heart of the world and purge the infection.

quests.title: The Host's Response
quests.text: The curse is not a curse. It is the world defending itself, and you are what it is defending against. Decide what you are.

regions.name: The Crown
regions.notes: Spawn. Rolling knolls on the whale's snout, warm under the near star. Session 1, levels 0 to 4 (G-grade). Weak System-placed beasts to learn the ropes; the first patch of Malignant Miasma sits at the edge of the knolls. The System's tutorial notices arrive here.

regions.name: Rake Canyons
regions.notes: Old scar canyons from something that once raked the whale's hide. Session 1 to 2, levels 4 to 10. First pale hunters, which gather where the land is wounded. Survivors from other spawn points shelter on the canyon rims.

regions.name: Twin Spouts
regions.notes: The blowholes. The way down is to ride the inhale: a timed descent (use a progress clock). Miss it and wait for the next breath while the pale hunters close in. Session 2, levels 8 to 12.

regions.name: Stormlung
regions.notes: Airway caves of roaring wind and pressure storms. Beast Lord 1, the Gale Warden, holds the deep chamber. Session 2 to 3, levels 10 to 15. Fight the Gale Warden before anyone evolves: once a character reaches E-grade, an F-grade lord deals them a third of its damage and gives a third of the XP. The E-grade evolution follows the fight.

regions.name: Red Rivers
regions.notes: Vessels: torrents of red current to ride or fight against. Beast Lord 2, the Clotmother, waits where the rivers meet. The reveal belongs here: a high-rarity Identify on the miasma, a dying pale hunter that does not attack, or a survivor who has worked it out. Session 3 to 4, levels 15 to 22.

regions.name: Marrow Halls
regions.notes: Bone galleries lit by marrow glow. Beast Lord 3, the Ossuary King. The party should know the truth by now; the halls are where they decide what to do with it. Session 4 to 5, levels 22 to 27.

regions.name: The Drum
regions.notes: The heart. Every beat shakes the chamber; World Stability tells the party how close the Host is to failing. The finale is the party's choice: purge the heart as the quest demands, or find another way. Session 5, levels 27 to 30.

items.name: Grazer Hide Vest

titles.name: Rapid Spread
titles.text: You have propagated through the Host faster than any before you.

titles.name: Lordbreaker
titles.text: You have brought down a Beast Lord of the tutorial.

skills.name: Inhale Rider
skills.description: You read the pull of great breaths and currents, and move with them instead of against them.
skills.effects: +1 step on checks to move with wind or current; halve fall damage while a draft pulls you.

skills.name: Miasma Sense
skills.description: You feel Malignant Miasma nearby as a prickle under the skin.
skills.flavor: It feels like a fever. Whose?
skills.effects: Know the direction of the nearest curse zone within a region.

skills.name: Heartbeat Hearing
skills.description: You hear the great pulse beneath everything, and what moves in time with it.
skills.flavor: Everything here keeps one rhythm. Except you.
skills.effects: Pale hunters and wardens cannot surprise you; +1 step to read the Drum's beat in the finale.

gmNotes.title: Tutorial overview
gmNotes.body: Five sessions, levels 0 to 30 (about 6 race levels a session), 30 in-game days. Route: The Crown → Rake Canyons → Twin Spouts → Stormlung (Beast Lord 1) → Red Rivers (Beast Lord 2, the reveal) → Marrow Halls (Beast Lord 3) → The Drum (finale). Hunger is narrated now and then to ground the players, never tracked.

gmNotes.title: World Stability
gmNotes.body: The main quest's World Stability starts at 100 and players can see it. Apply these actions in the Quests window: cleanse-curse-zone (−5), kill-pale-hunter (−2), kill-system-beast (+1), kill-beast-lord (+5). The players think falling stability is the curse winning; it is the Host losing the fight against them.

gmNotes.title: The reveal
gmNotes.body: The curse is the whale's immune response and the players are the infection. Seed it early (pale hunters only attack where the players have been; the miasma reads [Fever] at Uncommon) and land it in the Red Rivers. When it lands, reveal the hidden quest The Host's Response. A Rare Identify on the miasma gives it away: [The Host's Response].
